# `execution/preview/validator.ts`

This module validates preview environments by sending HTTP requests to verify they are reachable and responding correctly. It checks a required health-check endpoint (expecting HTTP 200) and optionally the root path, logging all results to `preview_logs`.

---

## Interfaces

### `ValidationCheck`

Represents the result of a single endpoint check.

| Member | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `endpoint` | `string` | The URL that was checked |
| `status` | `number` | The HTTP status code returned |
| `passed` | `boolean` | Whether the check was considered successful |
| `notes` | `string` | Additional information or error details about the check |

```ts
const check: ValidationCheck = {
  endpoint: "https://preview.example.com/health",
  status: 200,
  passed: true,
  notes: "Health check passed",
};
```

---

### `ValidationResult`

Represents the aggregated result of all checks performed during a preview validation.

| Member | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `passed` | `boolean` | Whether all checks passed overall |
| `checks` | `ValidationCheck[]` | The list of individual endpoint check results |

```ts
const result: ValidationResult = {
  passed: true,
  checks: [
    {
      endpoint: "https://preview.example.com/health",
      status: 200,
      passed: true,
      notes: "OK",
    },
  ],
};
```

## Functions

### `validatePreview`

```ts
import { validatePreview } from '...'
```

```ts
async function validatePreview(
  taskId: string,
  previewUrl: string,
  healthCheckPath: string
): Promise<ValidationResult>
```

Validates a preview environment by making HTTP requests to verify it is working. Hits the health-check path (expects HTTP 200) and optionally the root path. Results are logged to `preview_logs`.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `taskId` | `string` | The unique identifier for the task associated with this preview |
| `previewUrl` | `string` | The base URL of the preview environment to validate |
| `healthCheckPath` | `string` | The path appended to `previewUrl` for the health-check request |

#### Returns

`Promise<ValidationResult>` — Resolves with the aggregated validation result, including individual check outcomes.

#### Example

```ts
import { validatePreview } from './execution/preview/validator';

const result = await validatePreview(
  "task-abc-123",
  "https://preview.example.com",
  "/health"
);

if (result.passed) {
  console.log("Preview environment is healthy.");
} else {
  console.error("Validation failed:", result.checks);
}
```

### `checkEndpoint`

> ⚠️ **Not exported.** This function is internal to the module and cannot be imported directly.

```ts
async function checkEndpoint(url: string): Promise<ValidationCheck>
```

Makes a GET request to the given URL and returns a `ValidationCheck` result describing the HTTP status and whether the check passed.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `url` | `string` | The fully-qualified URL to send the GET request to |

#### Returns

`Promise<ValidationCheck>` — Resolves with the check result for the given endpoint.
